text: Trigger designs can be ranked by the certainty they give market participants: institution specific triggers presumably grant the most certainty, while regulatory trigger designs provide lower levels of certainty.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Initial Reflections on the Possible Application of Contingent Capital in Corporate Governance (2012). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=1998455

isBasedOn.name: Initial Reflections on the Possible Application of Contingent Capital in Corporate Governance

abstract: While institution-specific triggers would presum- ably grant most certainty to market participants, regulatory trig- ger designs could provide lower levels of certainty.
